close_reason: TryFrom<Certificate> impl now documents absence of TryFrom<&Certificate>
description: Only TryFrom<Certificate> (owned) was added; TryFrom<&Certificate> was not added to avoid conflict with the blanket impl From<&Certificate> (From implies Into, and TryFrom<&Certificate> would conflict). This asymmetry is not documented: the TryFrom impl has no doc comment explaining why the borrowed variant is absent. A future contributor will attempt to add TryFrom<&Certificate>, hit the blanket impl conflict, and have no explanation in the source to guide them.
title: TryFrom<Certificate> gap vs TryFrom<&Certificate> undocumented
